chart_materialization_coverage.definition: Cases with a separate pinned-engine chart artifact and reviewed target-anchor verification; this is not full-source-chart equivalence.

production_temporal_response_coverage.definition: Source-reviewed temporal-reaction rules available in the production reaction registry.

production_manifestation_ontology_covera.definition: Canonical manifestation ontology nodes available to Product.

production_manifestation_mapping_coverag.definition: Canonical manifestation mappings available to Product.

expert_replay_readiness.definition: Wang cases for which the current runtime can perform a full source-grounded expert replay, not merely retrieval or action selection.

method_scope_binding.definition: Case-to-MethodPattern bindings justified by exact target scope and explicit source linkage.

trace_completeness.definition: Completeness of an executed canonical or expert replay trace against its eligible evidence and expected partial order.

deterministic_reproducibility.definition: Repeatability of the Product behavior under identical pinned inputs; report-builder determinism is not a substitute for runtime fidelity.

contradiction_preservation.definition: Whether conflicting source-supported claims remain separately represented through the canonical runtime and evidence package.

unknown_or_insufficient_evidence_count.definition: Explicit count of source-insufficient or context-blocked benchmark assessments; it is not a count of real-world prediction errors.

method_fidelity_score.definition: A comparison score between eligible blind machine InferenceTrace outputs and source-demonstrated expert reasoning graphs.
